reference.target_truth: Independent target model origin on ground
reference.offset_scope: Explicit declared vehicle geometry applied to offline GT only; never target-derived or runtime compensation

declared_frame_evidence.world_evidence_boundary: Recorded runtime snapshot preferred. Older recordings without any world snapshot explicitly use current stage-specific source fallback; this is source-contract evidence, not a claimed historical runtime-world checksum.
declared_frame_evidence.source_contract: Gazebo world spherical_coordinates ENU with heading_deg=0; GPS north/east/up feed PX4 local NED; adapter reverses NED->ENU. Origin may differ; heading estimation error is not a world-axis calibration.

ego_alignment.method: Fixed identity rotation from declared Gazebo/PX4/ROS ENU source contract; Componentwise median translation from ego-only first 5 s by default. No target data or holdout refit.

distance.definition: Absolute opposite-side crossing relative to initial error sign; no percent step normalization. Settling is the start of the final active, in-band, continuously evidenced suffix lasting >=3 s through the interval end. Missing truth, inactive control and gaps interrupt the suffix; null settling is right-censored, never zero.

control_jitter.definition: Adjacent valid velocity commands within 0.2 s and same velocity mode, including tracking transients. This is command variation, not measured vehicle acceleration. HOLD/position/failsafe commands are excluded and counted separately.

position_control_jitter.definition: First and second time differences of consecutive valid MODE_POSITION commands with adjacent gaps at most 0.2 s. Second differences use the interval-midpoint separation for unequal steps. Includes intended tracking/reselection transients; this is setpoint variation, not measured aircraft velocity/acceleration or isolated sensor noise. HOLD, velocity and failsafe modes break differentiation; missing commands are not interpolated.

visual_control_metrics.definition: Box-center error uses one unique detection or the designated fresh matched track at the exact source image time; empty frames remain in the detection-opportunity denominator. It is conditional on observed detector boxes, not annotated physical center accuracy. Latency is acquisition to the first same-track active FOLLOW/PREDICT controller status (published with its command), deduplicated by task/track/accepted source image. The accepted image time is state.header minus prediction_age_s (rounded to microseconds); intervening timer predictions are not new images. Holds/failsafe are excluded. It includes estimator/controller delivery, ends before PX4/actuator response, and is a simulation-clock metric, not wall-time real-time capability.

short_shutter_prediction.definition: Fixed 10 Hz samples inside complete requested shutter intervals no longer than 0.75 s; only actual fresh PREDICTED navigation states contribute errors, using independently mapped truth at receipt-grid time. Request intervals alone do not prove rendered occlusion. No timer prediction outside those intervals is counted; missing states/truth retain coverage counts.

claim_boundary: No target truth fits navigation, its dimensions, heading, alignment, or controller. Primary map-to-GT alignment is independently frozen on vehicle-only first 5 s with declared identical ENU axes and separate ego holdout. Raw accuracy is deduplicated observed acquisition coverage, not image/stream availability; its velocity compares same-interval secants, not instantaneous KF derivatives. Primary KF coverage is fixed 10 Hz from the later of FOLLOW/calibration end through full recording end. It compares the received carried state directly with current GT, without ideal extrapolation to hide transport age. Navigation validity and active control are separate. Independent physical follow errors retain all long-loss/hover tails even if the state stream stops. Both base_link and original model-origin metrics are reported; historical evaluators/results are not changed. Distance band is max(0.5 m,10% requested distance), height band 0.25 m, final active dwell >=3 s; missing truth, stale data, ambiguous identity and inactive control censor settling. This is a moving-task transient audit, not a stationary step response or flight-safety certification.

bag.startup_unclocked_note: Successfully decoded messages before the first recorded /clock remain here with original recorder timestamps and exact CDR bytes; no simulation timestamp is assigned and they are excluded from timed metrics
bag.receive_time_note: received_sim_s uses the latest recorded /clock; recorder wall timestamps are not compared with sim time
bag.record_sequence_note: Zero-based filtered reader order, including clock/unreadable entries; equal operational timestamps retain this order

evaluation_source.scope: Offline evaluation source hashes; these do not replace or assert flight-frozen code hashes.
